title: Brief 8: cache reads are now most of the cost
when: 11 November 2026, 17:48 UTC (window: since brief 7, 10 November 17:44 UTC)
headline: 2,427,824 fresh tokens and 114 million cache reads; weighted at a tenth, cache reads are 82% of today's cost, and the biggest saving is splitting conductor-newsapp's one overnight session (100.5 million cache reads) into a session per round.

stats.label: weighted cost today (fresh + cache reads at a tenth)

for_you.ask: Overnight helpers (newsapp, teamapp): a new session for each round?
for_you.detail: conductor-newsapp ran six rounds in one session overnight: 1,203,440 fresh, 100,491,022 cache reads (weighted 11,252,542, the week's largest). Old: all rounds in one session. New: each round ends with a commit and a ledger line; the next starts in a new session from the repository. Saving: about half its cache reads, near 50 million a night (estimate).

for_you.ask: Fresh sessions with the full kit prompt for dashboard, dev, prompter and me (brief 7)?
for_you.detail: dashboard: 327,129 fresh a wake, 99% re-loading. A fresh first wake: 12,676.
Seven wakes: 1,123,467 fresh; savings 0, nothing applied. A7 and A4 also open.
options: Fresh session, brief only on new numbers
for_you.recommend: Fresh session, brief only on new numbers

sections.title: 2. Biggest three savings
items: Overnight marathon (A9): conductor-newsapp, 100.5 million cache reads in one session; weighted 11.3 million, 81% of today's weighted cost.
Re-loading (A6): dashboard 99% of fresh tokens re-loading; video-editor's second wake already 93%, as its session ages.
Prompter's context: 880,458 tokens carried per call, for a 13,432-token task. A new session per task (A6).

sections.title: 4. Agents not yet measuring
sections.text: Asked today: conductor-teamapp. Ran without a line: conductor (3 commits), social (1).

sections.title: 5. Data notes and 6. My own use
sections.text: Weighted = fresh + cache reads at a tenth. Correction: my wake 7 was 222,255 fresh, not 207,813 as its commit said. Inbox report sent. This wake: brief 9.

next: 12 November: brief 9, and the first night of A9 if yes.

friendly.title: Your agents' token use, 11 November
friendly.summary: One overnight helper ran six rounds in a single session and re-read 100 million tokens. Re-reading is cheap per token, but at that size it is now most of the cost. A new session per round (A9) would cut about half.
